hook.name: V21Hook
hook.description: Launchpad hook for heks.fun that charges a hook-delta fee on the pair's numeraire asset: 80% at pool creation decaying linearly to 1% over the first 10 seconds (anti-snipe), with liquidity additions restricted to the protocol vault and principal withdrawal permanently blocked. V2.1 adds an optional NFT-holder window: during this window, buys require a Merkle proof in hookData; sells and all swaps after the window close work without hookData.
